summary: The NSD (Niche Space Discovery) Website is a platform where you can access data from NASA's Sphere X Mission. At Niche, experience doesn't matter, which means anyone can use this platform to access the DATA. The NSD receives data from the NASA Sphere X website, and we project this data on our website. Once we have the projected data on our website, we have an assortment of tools to help you figure out any abnormalities between the frames of a "video" we have generated. So this means if you can spot an abnormality that no one has seen before using our website, you have just made a discovery. Anyone can discover Niche.
details: We display images and Data from the NASA Sphere X website for the public to come and analyze on our website. We've considered making this project as accessible and understandable as possible to the common man. We have used TypeScript and Python for our website.
